title: Payment API Internal Server Errors
diagnostic_steps: Inspect Payment API service logs for uncaught exceptions and 5xx error spikes.
Inspect downstream database and cache connectivity metrics.
Verify health of third-party payment gateways (Stripe, Adyen, PayPal).
Inspect ingress controller error rate and upstream timeout configurations.
Check circuit breaker status for downstream microservices.
recommended_remediation: Engage fallback payment gateway or circuit breaker to prevent cascading timeouts.
Scale payment-api replica count if CPU or request concurrency threshold is exceeded.
Roll back recent payment service release if error spike correlates with deployment.
Notify merchants and upstream partners according to SLA tier guidelines.
Monitor 5xx error rates until they return below 0.1% baseline.
